markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Normal only; second model and all neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%; others <1% | Near-certain Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996 / 68th percentile | Typical input quality |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; concept model links this to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · High score, but failed AI spot check, 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 7) · context · Above typical; descriptive only, spot check 8/20 [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion test is null (0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect classifier use. Evidence here includes Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Cell features unavailable: too few tumor nuclei found in sampled regions.
- Small test set (132 images): calibration CI is wide (ECE 0.05, up to 0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11** — confirm no infiltrating invasive front in the stroma.
2. **Regions 5, 6** — verify lobule architecture directly; the concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 10** — HoVer-Net counted 8 neoplastic and 14 epithelial nuclei; confirm they are benign.
